answer_1.quote: we develop and evaluate an NLG-chatbot that generates insights explanation by combining graphics and text.
answer_1.outputs: Textual explanations of dietary insights combined with visualisations

answer_4.quote: We run a human evaluation in which we compare our chatbot with traditional diet apps. Participants were assigned to either our chatbot or an app, and used it to take a 10-point quiz concerning the extraction of insights from a simulated food diary. At the end, participants expressed a feedback on the assigned tool.
answer_4.guideline: A 10-question quiz on diet analysis tasks and Likert-5 scale ratings for tool characteristics such as usefulness and speed.
